result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: overlapping delivery-time text on a popular restaurant card, and a missing comma in a restaurant name.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text overlaps itself as '25-30elivery' instead of a readable '25–30 min delivery' line.
issues.suggestion: Fix the time/fee row so minutes and 'delivery' sit on one line with proper spacing and no overlapping characters.

issues.description: The restaurant name is written as 'Smash Bros Burgers' without the expected comma (Smash Bros, Burgers).
issues.suggestion: Use the correct restaurant name with a comma if that is the official branding.
